bg.$description: Page ground. Text sits on it; never pure black or white in Dark and Dim.

surface.$description: Cards, panels and inputs raised above `bg`; the Reader panel.

ink.$description: Body and heading text on `bg` and `surface`.

ink-2.$description: Secondary text (captions, helper text) on `bg` and `surface`.

line.$description: Borders of controls, inputs and cards; 3:1 or better on `bg` and `surface`.

accent.$description: Links, primary buttons and selected states. Used as link text on `bg` and `surface`.

focus.$description: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset; 3:1 on every ground.

success.$description: Success text and icon on `bg` and `surface`; always paired with the word or a check mark.

warning.$description: Warning text and icon on `bg` and `surface`; always paired with the word or a triangle.

danger.$description: Error text and icon on `bg` and `surface`; always paired with the word or a cross.

success-cvd.$description: Success text and icon in color-vision mode (blue, off the red-green axis); pair with the word or a check mark.

warning-cvd.$description: Warning text and icon in color-vision mode (Okabe-Ito orange, darkened for text); pair with the word or a triangle.

danger-cvd.$description: Error text and icon in color-vision mode (Okabe-Ito vermillion, darkened for text); pair with the word or a cross.

target-min.$description: Minimum size of every interactive target.

gap-item.$description: Between items inside one group: list rows, label to value.

gap-group.$description: Between groups; at least 2x gap-item, so spacing alone shows what belongs together.

measure-max.$description: Widest allowed line length; above 75ch line height becomes at least 1.6.
